# vmamore.com.br v1 Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** A bilingual (pt-BR at `/`, en at `/en/`) one-page personal site with About + Experience + Education in a dark "terminal" style, generated by a small F# console app and deployed to GitHub Pages by GitHub Actions.

**Architecture:** An F# console app (`src/Site`) holds the profile as typed F# data, renders one page per language with Giraffe.ViewEngine, turns the About Markdown into HTML with Markdig, and writes `_site/`. A tiny `HttpListener` server previews `_site/` locally. xUnit tests cover formatting, rendering and the built output. A GitHub Actions workflow tests, builds and deploys on push to `main`.

**Tech Stack:** .NET 10 SDK, F#, Giraffe.ViewEngine 1.4.0, Markdig 1.6.0, xUnit 2.9.3, GitHub Actions (checkout v7, setup-dotnet v6, upload-pages-artifact v5, deploy-pages v5), JetBrains Mono v2.304 (OFL).

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-05-blog-design.md`

## Global Constraints

- Target framework `net10.0` for every project.
- Package versions exactly: `Giraffe.ViewEngine` 1.4.0, `Markdig` 1.6.0, `xunit` 2.9.3, `xunit.runner.visualstudio` 3.1.4, `Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk` 17.14.1, `coverlet.collector` 6.0.4.
- Base URL constant: `https://vmamore.com.br`. Pages: pt-BR `/` → `index.html`; en `/en/` → `en/index.html`.
- Always dark. Tokens: `--bg #15171a`, `--fg #d9d6cf`, `--muted #8a877f`, `--rule #2a2d31`, `--accent #7ee08f`.
- Font: JetBrains Mono v2.304 Regular + SemiBold woff2, self-hosted in `static/fonts/` with `OFL.txt`. No external requests at runtime. No JavaScript.
- No email anywhere on the site. Links: GitHub `https://github.com/vmamore`, LinkedIn `https://www.linkedin.com/in/vinicius-mamor%C3%A9-ab180b142/`.
- Text content must not be HTML-entity-encoded beyond `& < > "` (Giraffe's `str` encodes `ç` as `&#231;`; use the `text` helper from `Views.fs` instead).
- Durations count months inclusively; current roles end at the build month, which is injected (`today: YearMonth`) and never read from the clock outside `Program.fs`.
- All work on branch `feat/site-v1`. Never merge to `main`; Vinicius merges the PR.
- Commit messages end with `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.
- Commands below are for Git Bash, run from the repo root `D:\labs\my-blog`.

`tests/Site.Tests/TestHelpers.fs`:
```fsharp
module TestHelpers

open System
open System.IO
open Xunit
open Site.Domain

let ym year month : YearMonth = { Year = year; Month = month }

let contains (needle: string) (haystack: string) =
    Assert.True(haystack.Contains(needle, StringComparison.Ordinal), sprintf "Expected to find: %s" needle)

let notContains (needle: string) (haystack: string) =
    Assert.False(haystack.Contains(needle, StringComparison.Ordinal), sprintf "Did not expect to find: %s" needle)

let count (needle: string) (haystack: string) =
    let rec go (from: int) acc =
        match haystack.IndexOf(needle, from, StringComparison.Ordinal) with
        | -1 -> acc
        | i -> go (i + needle.Length) (acc + 1)
    go 0 0

/// Creates a fresh empty directory under the OS temp folder.
let tempDir () =
    let dir = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "vmamore-tests-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"))
    Directory.CreateDirectory dir |> ignore
    dir
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Write `src/Site/Domain.fs`**

```fsharp
module Site.Domain

open System

type Lang =
    | Pt
    | En

/// Text in both languages. A missing translation is a compile error.
type Localized = { Pt: string; En: string }

type YearMonth = { Year: int; Month: int }

type Role =
    { Title: Localized
      Start: YearMonth
      /// None = current role
      End: YearMonth option
      /// None = show title and dates only
      Summary: Localized option
      Tech: string list }

/// Dir is the folder name shown in the terminal listing, e.g. "stone". Roles are newest first.
type Company = { Name: string; Dir: string; Roles: Role list }

type Education =
    { School: string
      Course: Localized
      StartYear: int
      EndYear: int }

type Profile =
    { Name: string
      Headline: Localized
      Location: string
      /// (label, url)
      Links: (string * string) list
      /// newest first
      Companies: Company list
      Education: Education list }

module Localized =
    let get (lang: Lang) (text: Localized) =
        match lang with
        | Pt -> text.Pt
        | En -> text.En

module YearMonth =
    let ofDateTime (date: DateTime) = { Year = date.Year; Month = date.Month }

module Company =
    /// Earliest role start → latest role end, or None when any role is current.
    let span (company: Company) : YearMonth * YearMonth option =
        let start = company.Roles |> List.map (fun r -> r.Start) |> List.min
        let finish =
            if company.Roles |> List.exists (fun r -> r.End.IsNone) then
                None
            else
                Some(company.Roles |> List.choose (fun r -> r.End) |> List.max)
        start, finish

module Profile =
    let careerStart (profile: Profile) =
        profile.Companies
        |> List.collect (fun c -> c.Roles)
        |> List.map (fun r -> r.Start)
        |> List.min
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write `src/Site/I18n.fs`** and add it to `Site.fsproj` after `Domain.fs`

```fsharp
module Site.I18n

open Site.Domain

let code lang =
    match lang with
    | Pt -> "pt"
    | En -> "en"

let htmlLang lang =
    match lang with
    | Pt -> "pt-BR"
    | En -> "en"

let pagePath lang =
    match lang with
    | Pt -> "/"
    | En -> "/en/"

let outputFile lang =
    match lang with
    | Pt -> "index.html"
    | En -> "en/index.html"

type Strings =
    { CmdAbout: string
      CmdExperience: string
      CmdEducation: string
      Description: string
      BuiltWith: string
      HostedOn: string
      Source: string }

let strings lang =
    match lang with
    | Pt ->
        { CmdAbout = "cat sobre.md"
          CmdExperience = "ls experiencia/"
          CmdEducation = "cat formacao.md"
          Description = "Vinicius Mamoré, engenheiro de software backend: sobre mim e experiência profissional."
          BuiltWith = "feito com"
          HostedOn = "hospedado no"
          Source = "código-fonte" }
    | En ->
        { CmdAbout = "cat about.md"
          CmdExperience = "ls experience/"
          CmdEducation = "cat education.md"
          Description = "Vinicius Mamoré, backend software engineer: about me and work experience."
          BuiltWith = "built with"
          HostedOn = "hosted on"
          Source = "source" }

let private monthsPt =
    [| "jan"; "fev"; "mar"; "abr"; "mai"; "jun"; "jul"; "ago"; "set"; "out"; "nov"; "dez" |]

let private monthsEn =
    [| "Jan"; "Feb"; "Mar"; "Apr"; "May"; "Jun"; "Jul"; "Aug"; "Sep"; "Oct"; "Nov"; "Dec" |]

let formatMonth lang (date: YearMonth) =
    let names =
        match lang with
        | Pt -> monthsPt
        | En -> monthsEn
    sprintf "%s %d" names.[date.Month - 1] date.Year

let private present lang =
    match lang with
    | Pt -> "atual"
    | En -> "Present"

let formatRange lang (start: YearMonth) (finish: YearMonth option) =
    let last =
        match finish with
        | Some f -> formatMonth lang f
        | None -> present lang
    sprintf "%s – %s" (formatMonth lang start) last

/// Months from start to finish, counting both ends (LinkedIn's convention).
let monthsInclusive (start: YearMonth) (finish: YearMonth) =
    (finish.Year - start.Year) * 12 + (finish.Month - start.Month) + 1

let formatDuration lang (totalMonths: int) =
    let years, months = totalMonths / 12, totalMonths % 12
    match lang with
    | Pt ->
        let y = if years = 1 then "1 ano" else sprintf "%d anos" years
        let m = if months = 1 then "1 mês" else sprintf "%d meses" months
        match years, months with
        | 0, _ -> m
        | _, 0 -> y
        | _ -> sprintf "%s e %s" y m
    | En ->
        let y = if years = 1 then "1 year" else sprintf "%d years" years
        let m = if months = 1 then "1 month" else sprintf "%d months" months
        match years, months with
        | 0, _ -> m
        | _, 0 -> y
        | _ -> sprintf "%s %s" y m

/// Duration text for a role or company; a current one (None) ends at `today`.
let duration lang (start: YearMonth) (finish: YearMonth option) (today: YearMonth) =
    formatDuration lang (monthsInclusive start (defaultArg finish today))

/// Completed years from start to today (used for "{{years}} years of experience").
let fullYearsBetween (start: YearMonth) (today: YearMonth) =
    ((today.Year - start.Year) * 12 + (today.Month - start.Month)) / 12
```

```fsharp
module Site.Views

open Giraffe.ViewEngine
open Site.Domain
open Site.I18n

let baseUrl = "https://vmamore.com.br"

type PageModel =
    { Lang: Lang
      Profile: Profile
      AboutHtml: string
      Today: YearMonth }

/// Escapes only what HTML requires. Giraffe's `str` also turns "ç" into "&#231;",
/// which renders fine but makes the source unreadable.
let escape (s: string) =
    s.Replace("&", "&amp;").Replace("<", "&lt;").Replace(">", "&gt;").Replace("\"", "&quot;")

let text (s: string) = rawText (escape s)

let private dateLine lang today (start: YearMonth) (finish: YearMonth option) =
    sprintf "%s · %s" (formatRange lang start finish) (duration lang start finish today)

let private roleView lang today (glyph: string) (role: Role) =
    let head =
        p [ _class "role-head" ] [
            span [ _class "role-title" ] [ text (Localized.get lang role.Title) ]
            span [ _class "dim" ] [ text (dateLine lang today role.Start role.End) ]
        ]
    let summary =
        role.Summary
        |> Option.map (fun s -> p [ _class "summary" ] [ text (Localized.get lang s) ])
        |> Option.toList
    let tech =
        if List.isEmpty role.Tech then []
        else [ p [ _class "tech" ] [ text (String.concat ", " role.Tech) ] ]
    li [ _class "role" ] [
        span [ _class "branch"; attr "aria-hidden" "true" ] [ text glyph ]
        div [ _class "role-body" ] ([ head ] @ summary @ tech)
    ]

let private companyView lang today (company: Company) =
    let start, finish = Company.span company
    let lastIndex = List.length company.Roles - 1
    let spanLine =
        if List.length company.Roles > 1 then
            [ span [ _class "dim" ] [ text (dateLine lang today start finish) ] ]
        else
            []
    li [ _class "company" ] [
        p [ _class "company-head" ] ([ strong [ attr "title" company.Name ] [ text (company.Dir + "/") ] ] @ spanLine)
        ol [ _class "roles" ] (
            company.Roles
            |> List.mapi (fun i r -> roleView lang today (if i = lastIndex then "└─" else "├─") r)
        )
    ]

let private educationView lang (e: Education) =
    li [] [
        strong [] [ text e.School ]
        span [ _class "dim" ] [ text (sprintf "%s · %d – %d" (Localized.get lang e.Course) e.StartYear e.EndYear) ]
    ]

let private langSwitch current =
    let item lang =
        if lang = current then
            span [ _class "current"; attr "aria-current" "page" ] [ text (code lang) ]
        else
            a [ _href (pagePath lang); attr "hreflang" (htmlLang lang); attr "lang" (htmlLang lang) ] [ text (code lang) ]
    nav [ _class "lang"; attr "aria-label" "Language / Idioma" ] [ item Pt; text " / "; item En ]

let sourceUrl = "https://github.com/vmamore/vmamore.github.io"

let private stack =
    [ "F#", "https://fsharp.org"
      "Giraffe.ViewEngine", "https://github.com/giraffe-fsharp/Giraffe.ViewEngine"
      "Markdig", "https://github.com/xoofx/markdig"
      "JetBrains Mono", "https://www.jetbrains.com/lp/mono/" ]

/// Puts `separator` between nodes: [a; b; c] → [a; sep; b; sep; c].
let private joinWith (separator: XmlNode) (nodes: XmlNode list) =
    nodes |> List.mapi (fun i n -> if i = 0 then [ n ] else [ separator; n ]) |> List.concat

let private footerView lang (today: YearMonth) (name: string) =
    let s = strings lang
    let stackLinks = stack |> List.map (fun (label, url) -> a [ _href url ] [ text label ])
    footer [] [
        p [] [ text (sprintf "© %d %s" today.Year name) ]
        p [ _class "built" ] (
            [ text (s.BuiltWith + " ") ]
            @ joinWith (text ", ") stackLinks
            @ [ text (sprintf " · %s " s.HostedOn)
                a [ _href "https://pages.github.com" ] [ text "GitHub Pages" ]
                text " · "
                a [ _href sourceUrl ] [ text s.Source ] ]
        )
    ]

let private alternate (hreflang: string) (path: string) =
    link [ _rel "alternate"; attr "hreflang" hreflang; _href (baseUrl + path) ]

let page (model: PageModel) =
    let lang = model.Lang
    let prof = model.Profile
    let s = strings lang
    html [ attr "lang" (htmlLang lang) ] [
        head [] [
            meta [ _charset "utf-8" ]
            meta [ _name "viewport"; _content "width=device-width, initial-scale=1" ]
            title [] [ text (sprintf "%s · %s" prof.Name (Localized.get lang prof.Headline)) ]
            meta [ _name "description"; _content s.Description ]
            meta [ _name "color-scheme"; _content "dark" ]
            link [ _rel "canonical"; _href (baseUrl + pagePath lang) ]
            alternate "pt-BR" (pagePath Pt)
            alternate "en" (pagePath En)
            alternate "x-default" (pagePath Pt)
            link [ _rel "icon"; _type "image/svg+xml"; _href "/favicon.svg" ]
            link [ _rel "preload"; _href "/fonts/JetBrainsMono-Regular.woff2"; attr "as" "font"; _type "font/woff2"; attr "crossorigin" "" ]
            link [ _rel "stylesheet"; _href "/style.css" ]
        ]
        body [] [
            div [ _class "page" ] [
                header [ _class "top" ] [ langSwitch lang ]
                main [] [
                    section [ _id "whoami" ] [
                        p [ _class "cmd"; attr "aria-hidden" "true" ] [ text "whoami" ]
                        h1 [ _class "name" ] [ text prof.Name ]
                        p [ _class "dim" ] [ text (sprintf "%s · %s" (Localized.get lang prof.Headline) prof.Location) ]
                        p [ _class "links" ] (
                            prof.Links |> List.map (fun (label, url) -> a [ _href url ] [ text (label.ToLowerInvariant()) ])
                        )
                    ]
                    section [ _id "about" ] [
                        h2 [ _class "cmd" ] [ text s.CmdAbout ]
                        div [ _class "prose" ] [ rawText model.AboutHtml ]
                    ]
                    section [ _id "experience" ] [
                        h2 [ _class "cmd" ] [ text s.CmdExperience ]
                        ol [ _class "companies" ] (prof.Companies |> List.map (companyView lang model.Today))
                    ]
                    section [ _id "education" ] [
                        h2 [ _class "cmd" ] [ text s.CmdEducation ]
                        ul [ _class "education" ] (prof.Education |> List.map (educationView lang))
                    ]
                    p [ _class "cmd"; attr "aria-hidden" "true" ] [ span [ _class "caret" ] [] ]
                ]
                footerView lang model.Today prof.Name
            ]
        ]
    ]

let render (model: PageModel) = RenderView.AsString.htmlDocument (page model)
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write `src/Site/Server.fs`** and add it to `Site.fsproj` after `Views.fs`

```fsharp
module Site.Server

open System
open System.IO
open System.Net

let contentType (path: string) =
    match Path.GetExtension(path).ToLowerInvariant() with
    | ".html" -> "text/html; charset=utf-8"
    | ".css" -> "text/css; charset=utf-8"
    | ".svg" -> "image/svg+xml"
    | ".woff2" -> "font/woff2"
    | ".txt" -> "text/plain; charset=utf-8"
    | _ -> "application/octet-stream"

/// Maps a URL path to a file inside outDir. Folders map to their index.html.
let resolve (outDir: string) (urlPath: string) : string option =
    let root = Path.GetFullPath(outDir).TrimEnd(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar, Path.AltDirectorySeparatorChar)
    let relative = Uri.UnescapeDataString(urlPath).TrimStart('/')
    let candidate = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(root, relative))
    let inside =
        candidate.Equals(root, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
        || candidate.StartsWith(root + string Path.DirectorySeparatorChar, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
    if not inside then
        None
    elif Directory.Exists candidate then
        let index = Path.Combine(candidate, "index.html")
        if File.Exists index then Some index else None
    elif File.Exists candidate then
        Some candidate
    else
        None

let serve (outDir: string) (port: int) =
    use listener = new HttpListener()
    listener.Prefixes.Add(sprintf "http://localhost:%d/" port)
    listener.Start()
    printfn "Serving %s at http://localhost:%d/ (Ctrl+C to stop)" outDir port
    while true do
        let context = listener.GetContext()
        let response = context.Response
        match resolve outDir context.Request.Url.AbsolutePath with
        | Some file ->
            let bytes = File.ReadAllBytes file
            response.ContentType <- contentType file
            response.ContentLength64 <- int64 bytes.Length
            response.OutputStream.Write(bytes, 0, bytes.Length)
        | None -> response.StatusCode <- 404
        response.Close()
```

module BuildTests

open System
open System.IO
open System.Text.RegularExpressions
open Xunit
open Site
open TestHelpers

let private root = Build.findRoot AppContext.BaseDirectory
let private today = ym 2026 11

let private build () =
    let out = Path.Combine(tempDir (), "_site")
    Build.run root out today
    out

[<Fact>]
let ``findRoot finds the folder with content and static`` () =
    Assert.True(Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(root, "content")))
    Assert.True(File.Exists(Path.Combine(root, "static", "CNAME")))

[<Fact>]
let ``renderAbout replaces the years token and renders markdown`` () =
    Assert.Equal("<p>com 8 anos <em>x</em></p>\n", Build.renderAbout "com {{years}} anos *x*" 8)

[<Fact>]
let ``isSafeOutDir refuses the repo, its ancestors and its source folders`` () =
    let repo = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "r", "repo")
    Assert.False(Build.isSafeOutDir repo repo)
    Assert.False(Build.isSafeOutDir repo (Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "r")))
    Assert.False(Build.isSafeOutDir repo (Path.Combine(repo, "content")))
    Assert.False(Build.isSafeOutDir repo (Path.Combine(repo, "src")))
    Assert.True(Build.isSafeOutDir repo (Path.Combine(repo, "_site")))
    Assert.True(Build.isSafeOutDir repo (Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "elsewhere", "_site")))

[<Fact>]
let ``build writes both pages and copies static files recursively`` () =
    let out = build ()
    for file in
        [ "index.html"; "en/index.html"; "style.css"; "CNAME"; "favicon.svg"
          "fonts/JetBrainsMono-Regular.woff2"; "fonts/JetBrainsMono-SemiBold.woff2"; "fonts/OFL.txt" ] do
        Assert.True(File.Exists(Path.Combine(out, file)), sprintf "missing %s" file)
    Assert.Equal("vmamore.com.br", File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(out, "CNAME")).Trim())

[<Fact>]
let ``build fills in years of experience in both languages`` () =
    let out = build ()
    let pt = File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(out, "index.html"))
    let en = File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(out, "en", "index.html"))
    contains "8 anos de experiência" pt
    contains "8 years of experience" en
    notContains "{{years}}" pt
    notContains "{{years}}" en
    contains "<html lang=\"pt-BR\">" pt
    contains "<html lang=\"en\">" en

[<Fact>]
let ``every root-relative link and font url resolves to a built file`` () =
    let out = build ()
    let pages = [ "index.html"; "en/index.html" ] |> List.map (fun f -> File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(out, f)))
    let css = File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(out, "style.css"))
    let fromPages =
        pages
        |> List.collect (fun html ->
            [ for m in Regex.Matches(html, "(?:href|src)=\"(/[^\"]*)\"") -> m.Groups.[1].Value ])
    let fromCss = [ for m in Regex.Matches(css, "url\\(\"(/[^\"]+)\"\\)") -> m.Groups.[1].Value ]
    let urls = fromPages @ fromCss |> List.distinct
    Assert.Contains("/en/", urls)
    Assert.Contains("/fonts/JetBrainsMono-SemiBold.woff2", urls)
    for url in urls do
        Assert.True((Server.resolve out url).IsSome, sprintf "broken link %s" url)

[<Fact>]
let ``a rebuild wipes stale files`` () =
    let out = build ()
    File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(out, "stale.txt"), "old")
    Build.run root out today
    Assert.False(File.Exists(Path.Combine(out, "stale.txt")))

- [ ] **Step 4: Write `src/Site/Build.fs`** and add it to `Site.fsproj` after `Server.fs`

```fsharp
module Site.Build

open System
open System.IO
open Markdig
open Site.Domain
open Site.Views // brings PageModel's record labels into scope

let findRoot (start: string) =
    let rec go (dir: DirectoryInfo) =
        if isNull dir then
            failwithf "Could not find the repo root (a folder with content/ and static/) above %s" start
        elif Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(dir.FullName, "content"))
             && Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(dir.FullName, "static")) then
            dir.FullName
        else
            go dir.Parent
    go (DirectoryInfo start)

let private withSeparator (path: string) =
    Path.GetFullPath(path).TrimEnd(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar, Path.AltDirectorySeparatorChar)
    + string Path.DirectorySeparatorChar

/// The build wipes outDir first, so refuse anything that would delete source:
/// inside the repo only `_site` is allowed; outside it, anything but an ancestor of the repo.
let isSafeOutDir (root: string) (outDir: string) =
    let repo = withSeparator root
    let out = withSeparator outDir
    let site = withSeparator (Path.Combine(root, "_site"))
    let ignoreCase = StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase
    if out.StartsWith(repo, ignoreCase) then out.StartsWith(site, ignoreCase)
    else not (repo.StartsWith(out, ignoreCase))

let renderAbout (markdown: string) (years: int) =
    Markdown.ToHtml(markdown.Replace("{{years}}", string years))

let rec private copyDir (source: string) (target: string) =
    Directory.CreateDirectory target |> ignore
    for file in Directory.GetFiles source do
        File.Copy(file, Path.Combine(target, Path.GetFileName file), true)
    for dir in Directory.GetDirectories source do
        copyDir dir (Path.Combine(target, Path.GetFileName dir))

let run (root: string) (outDir: string) (today: YearMonth) =
    if not (isSafeOutDir root outDir) then
        invalidOp (sprintf "Refusing to build into %s: it would delete source files." outDir)
    if Directory.Exists outDir then
        Directory.Delete(outDir, true)
    copyDir (Path.Combine(root, "static")) outDir
    let years = I18n.fullYearsBetween (Profile.careerStart Data.profile) today
    for lang in [ Pt; En ] do
        let markdown = File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(root, "content", sprintf "about.%s.md" (I18n.code lang)))
        let html =
            Views.render
                { Lang = lang
                  Profile = Data.profile
                  AboutHtml = renderAbout markdown years
                  Today = today }
        let file = Path.Combine(outDir, I18n.outputFile lang)
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName file) |> ignore
        File.WriteAllText(file, html)
```

Note on `renderAbout` test: Markdig ends paragraphs with `\n`. If the installed Markdig version emits a different trailing newline, adjust the **expected string in the test** to what `Markdown.ToHtml` returns for that input — this is a formatting detail of the library, not behavior we own.

- [ ] **Step 5: Replace `src/Site/Program.fs`**

```fsharp
module Site.Program

open System
open System.IO
open Site.Domain

let private build root outDir today =
    Build.run root outDir today
    printfn "Built %s" outDir

[<EntryPoint>]
let main argv =
    let root = Build.findRoot Environment.CurrentDirectory
    let today = YearMonth.ofDateTime DateTime.Today
    let defaultOut = Path.Combine(root, "_site")
    match List.ofArray argv with
    | [ "build" ] ->
        build root defaultOut today
        0
    | [ "build"; out ] ->
        build root (Path.GetFullPath out) today
        0
    | [ "serve" ] ->
        build root defaultOut today
        Server.serve defaultOut 5000
        0
    | _ ->
        eprintfn "usage: dotnet run --project src/Site -- build [outDir] | serve"
        1
```

### Task 7: GitHub Actions workflow and README

**Files:**
- Create: `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`
- Create: `README.md`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: CLI `dotnet run --project src/Site -c Release -- build _site`; `dotnet test` at repo root

- [ ] **Step 1: Write `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`**

```yaml
name: deploy

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v6
        with:
          dotnet-version: 10.0.x
      - name: Test
        run: dotnet test
      - name: Build site
        run: dotnet run --project src/Site -c Release -- build _site
      - name: Upload Pages artifact
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v5
        with:
          path: _site

  deploy:
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: pages
      cancel-in-progress: false
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v5
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Write `README.md`**

````markdown
# vmamore.com.br

Personal site of Vinicius Mamoré. Built with a small F# static site generator
(Giraffe.ViewEngine + Markdig) and deployed to GitHub Pages.

## Run locally

```pwsh
dotnet test
dotnet run --project src/Site -- serve   # http://localhost:5000
```

`dotnet run --project src/Site -- build` writes the site to `_site/`.

## Edit content

- Experience, headline, links, education: `src/Site/Data.fs` (every text has `Pt` and `En`).
- About text: `content/about.pt.md` and `content/about.en.md`. `{{years}}` becomes the years since the first job.
- Styles: `static/style.css`.

Pushing to `main` runs the tests and deploys.

## Domain (registro.br)

1. Register `vmamore.com.br` at registro.br.
2. In the domain's DNS zone ("Editar zona"), add:
   - `A` `@` → `185.199.108.153`, `185.199.109.153`, `185.199.110.153`, `185.199.111.153`
   - `CNAME` `www` → `vmamore.github.io`
3. In GitHub: Settings → Pages → Custom domain → `vmamore.com.br`, then tick "Enforce HTTPS" once the certificate is ready.
4. Recommended: verify the domain under your GitHub account Settings → Pages.

## License

Content © Vinicius Mamoré. JetBrains Mono is under the SIL Open Font License (`static/fonts/OFL.txt`).
````
